_comment: ngsolve thermal_structural#5 (GridFunction.name is read-only). Verified 2026-08-03 on NGSolve 6.2.2604. Reading the property returns the constructor-supplied name; type(gf).__dict__['name'] is a property whose fset is None; assigning gfu.name = 'displacement' raises AttributeError whose str() is exactly "property of 'GridFunction' object has no setter", and the name is left unchanged. The documented workaround is complete: VTKOutput(mesh, coefs=[...], names=['temperature','displacement']) accepts the labels and Do() writes the file.
